protocol: Same 120 specialist training,80 fit,40 gate,160 previously reported classification. New primary measurement panel: all 400 previously unevaluated val images, no diagnosis labels used or inferred. First run contrast specialist, inspect its predicted contours on top of the image, probability confidence, solidity, retention and green-channel edge support; frozen VLM grades the overlay equally in all routing arms. Optional color expert posterior fusion. Compare always keep, always fuse, no-learning quality trigger (clear visual mismatch or cup confidence below .55) and learned quality trigger. Same at-most-two specialist budget, report actual reviews. Fit-only paired error reduction; differences <=.002 do not reward a review. Four prespecified shallow-tree/cutoff candidates fit to paired improvements. Native HCL consolidates fit feedback and VLM chooses one executable bounded SkillOpt edit using HCL summaries and five-fold out-of-fold utility. This hybrid does not isolate HCL from fitted numerical rules. Candidate frozen regardless of gate, report all raw arms. Deploy if gate error strictly lower and BACC nondecreasing. Paired image bootstrap 95% intervals. Frozen earlier threshold .5, classification secondary.
